title: Founding of Llana Hermosa
description: Dominican priests establish the settlement as an independent parish under the patronage of St. Peter of Verona, naming it 'Llana Hermosa' (beautiful plain), which later shortened to Hermosa.

title: WWII and the Death March
description: Hermosa lies along the route of the Bataan Death March. Sacrifice Valley, within the municipality, becomes a lasting site of wartime memory and later a place of pilgrimage and reflection.

title: Roosevelt National Park Established
description: A tract of grassland and old-growth forest spanning Hermosa and Dinalupihan is declared a national park under Governor-General Theodore Roosevelt Jr., later reclassified as the Roosevelt Protected Landscape in 2000.

title: Seal of Good Local Governance
description: Hermosa receives the Seal of Good Local Governance (SGLG) from DILG Region III, one of 12 Bataan LGUs honored that year.

title: Hermosa Ecozone Industrial Park
description: A PEZA-registered 162-hectare industrial zone within a 478-hectare mixed-use development advances Hermosa's position as an agro-industrial hub, accessible via the SCTEx Dinalupihan Interchange.
